Character-aligned furigana data derived from JmdictFurigana and JmnedictFurigana.
Project: https://github.com/Doublevil/JmdictFurigana
Release: 2.3.1+2026-10-25
Upstream dictionary projects: JMdict, JMnedict, KANJIDIC, Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group.
https://www.edrdg.org/
Data license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0.
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
Changes: JSON records compacted to word + reading keys; site-specific verified name splits added; source readings preserved.
Derived browser dataset: furigana-index.json.gz in this directory.
